verdict.rationale: Lighthouse publishes pages for nationality-restricted pathways: TN, which is tied to the USMCA and so to Canadian and Mexican nationals, and E-3, which is Australia-specific. It also has an E-2 treaty-countries blog URL and offers consular interview support as a Plus service. These touch origin-country reach only indirectly. Missing for 10: country-specific backlog or visa-bulletin guidance, published consulate processing-time content, dedicated pages for founders from particular countries, and substantive quoted content from the treaty-country guide.

support.subject: As a founder abroad, the provider publishes origin-country-specific guidance — consulate processing, country backlogs, or dedicated pages for founders from my country
